summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, containing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and proxy materials for the AGM scheduled for July 31, 2026. The filing covers routine director elections and re-elections, including new directors Kevin Egan and Jeff Elliott, and other standard AGM resolutions. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine annual meeting notice and proxy circular. The filing does not contain any event-driven special situation, and is therefore classified as None.
